text:
Alice: Anyone else seeing duplicate POSTs when a retrofit coroutine call is cancelled & retried? Only repro on Pixel 8 / Android 14 in our sample app.
Ben: Repro here. Looks like duplicate body because the request gets retried but the multipart body isn't rewindable.
Carla: Is this the same as the unrepeatable-body bug we saw earlier? What's new?
Dylan: Might be an interaction between our CookieJar + authenticator flow. On 401 the authenticator updates cookies on main thread, concurrent retry uses stale connection/body.
Alice: Minimal repro in sampleapp: start upload -> toggle airplane mode -> restore -> server 401 -> authenticator refresh -> request retried -> duplicate upload. Logs: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST /upload
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 Unauthorized
I/Auth: refreshing token...
I/OkHttp: --> POST /upload (retry #1)
I/OkHttp: --> POST /upload (duplicate body detected)
```
Ben: In our unit tests the RequestBody was rewindable, but multipart stream implemented with a counting sink isn't after first attempt. Body closed.
Carla: Workaround is buffering multipart to a temp file before send, but that's heavy for mobile.
Dylan: Also seeing CookieJar#setCookie calling SharedPrefs on main thread during authenticator, which can block dispatcher and cause weird retry ordering.
Alice: Any low-friction suggestions? We want parity with iOS (which doesn't show this).
Ben: Try disabling OkHttp#setRetryOnConnectionFailure as an experiment, or make CallTimeout shorter to fail faster — both change semantics though.
Carla: For the SDK, we could detect non-repeatable bodies and fail fast with a clear error instead of silently retrying. Emit an analytics event when a duplicate-body retry is prevented.
Dylan: @Alice can you paste the stacktrace from the counting sink NPE? Also add repro steps to the sampleapp issue.
Alice: Stacktrace shows NPE in CountingSink.write when second attempt hits closed sink. Pushed a branch with sampleapp repro: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/42 (branch: alice/multipart-repro).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: test build for branch alice/multipart-repro at 11:30am.
Ben: I'll try a minimal OkHttp-only repro tomorrow. If it's the CookieJar blocking, moving cookie updates to background executor might fix it.
Carla: :thumbsup: If we adopt detect-and-fail for non-repeatable bodies, add clear upgrade notes in CHANGELOG so customers know behavior changed.
Dylan: Filed internal ticket RNFR-2345 to triage and track SDK parity impact. @Carla can you add a PR template for sampleapp repros?
Alice: Thanks all — I'll add more logs, HAR, and mark this P1 for SDK parity work.
